title: Read through a freed alias
description: An alias is another pointer to the same object. You can see why clearing one pointer leaves the other pointer unchanged.

steps.description: Node contains an integer value and a pointer to the next node.
new creates a Node. Assigning n to alias gives both pointers the same address.
delete releases the Node. Assigning nullptr changes n alone.
alias still holds the released address. Reading alias->val causes undefined behavior, so the displayed value has no guarantee.
